component_summary_animated_text: Text that comes in a letter or a word at a time.
component_summary_animation: Fades, slides or zooms its child in and out, in CSS only.
component_summary_badge: A small label for a status, a count or a tag.
component_summary_breadcrumb: Where a page sits, on one line, folding into a menu when it runs out of room.
component_summary_button: Does something when clicked, like sending a form.
component_summary_calendar: A month grid for picking a day or a range.
component_summary_card: A surface for one thing, like a summary or a setting.
component_summary_checkbox: Turns one option on or off, or picks several.
component_summary_combobox: A text field with suggestions under it.
component_summary_date_picker: A button that opens a calendar.
component_summary_details: A summary that opens to show the rest.
component_summary_diagram: Boxes, stores, queues and arrows for a system diagram, drawn from a list of what goes where.
component_summary_dialog: Opens over the page and keeps focus until it’s closed.
component_summary_form: A native form wired to react-hook-form.
component_summary_frame: A section that fills the window, inset by a gap on every side, with rounded corners.
component_summary_heading: A heading from h1 to h6, whose size can differ from its level.
component_summary_hyper_link: Goes to another page, site or spot on the page.
component_summary_image: An image with a loading spinner and a fallback.
component_summary_input_group: A field with icons, text or buttons inside its border.
component_summary_layout: Puts its child on a grid, with no wrapper element.
component_summary_list: A ul or ol laid out as a grid.
component_summary_markdown: A line or a whole document of Markdown, as components.
component_summary_navigation: A list of links to other pages.
component_summary_page_indicator: A column of dots, one for each full-screen section, that link to it.
component_summary_popover: A small panel that opens next to its trigger.
component_summary_radio_group: Picks one option from a short list.
component_summary_scroll_indicator: A bar that fills as the page scrolls.
component_summary_segmented: Picks one of a few options side by side.
component_summary_select: Picks one option from a long list.
component_summary_sheet: A panel that slides in from an edge of the page.
component_summary_skeleton: A placeholder shaped like the content that’s loading.
component_summary_status: A title and message about how something went.
component_summary_switch: On or off for a setting that applies at once.
component_summary_table: Rows and columns of data, with headers.
component_summary_text: Body copy and the inline elements in it.
component_summary_textarea: A text field for more than one line.
component_summary_video: A muted MP4 that plays on its own, looped, without controls.

docs_home_tagline: A design system built on the platform, not on top of it.
